title: Clearer calls and more control over your data
changes: Voice calls keep the chat and message box visible. Speaking names update even when the gallery is collapsed.
Open Metadata in the navigation to see what relays, file hosts and call connections can learn. Looking up your public IP and approximate location is optional.
Supported photos, videos, audio and documents are cleaned locally before sharing. Files that cannot be cleaned stay unsent; the original stays on your device.
Read what changed before updating, and find these notes again in Settings → What’s new.
